limits: Fixed recipe and typed interfaces; conservative exact state contracts, no arbitrary closure equivalence.
Inheritance selection covers intermediate stages without new result exports.
Original graph effects and Run publication still execute; no general Entry-publication elimination.
Extraction weights model container transfer only. Compile time, larger JSON and runtime selection reads are extra costs; no new acceleration claim.
The 6-to-2 allocation reduction is the existing carry mechanism made selectable, not additional savings over f4fd21cb.
